## Recipe checklist

Skip this section for foundation work. The full contract is in [CONTRIBUTING.md](../blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md).

- [ ] Changes are confined to `recipes/NN-slug/`, plus the generated README regions regenerated by the integration worker (nothing else outside the recipe folder)
- [ ] README regenerated with `python tools/render_catalog.py` after updating against current `main`, before final review; `--check` passes (it is expected to be red before this integration step)
- [ ] `git diff --raw -M origin/main...HEAD` lists only `recipes/NN-slug/` paths and `README.md` (it shows modes; reject `120000` and `160000`, any mode change such as `100644 100755`, and any type change), with no symlink, mode or type change (including for `README.md`, which stays a regular file of mode `100644`), rename or deletion out of scope; `README.md` equals `render(<base README>, <head catalog>)` (see CONTRIBUTING.md; the check applies to a pull request on branch `recipe/<slug>` that closes an issue numbered 1 to 60, and fails closed if only one of the two holds or the slug cannot be resolved)
- [ ] Notebook runs top to bottom offline, with no key and no network
- [ ] Live path is opt-in and uses the same question definitions
- [ ] Every response fixture records its provenance; the notebook states which mode it ran in
- [ ] No claim about Jev's quality, latency, or cost without recorded live inference
- [ ] Fixtures are synthetic, include the hard cases, and carry gold labels
- [ ] Python owns every side effect; actions are simulated
- [ ] Evaluation against gold labels, with the baseline the issue names
- [ ] Every acceptance criterion on the issue is met
